# EditPad

> > EditPad is a comprehensive AI-powered writing platform offering free tools for academic writing, content creation, plagiarism detection, and creative text generation.

EditPad provides a suite of integrated writing assistance tools designed for students, educators, and content creators. The platform combines AI-powered text generation, editing, and analysis capabilities with traditional writing utilities, all accessible without mandatory sign-up.

## Key Topics

- Plagiarism Detection
- AI Writing Assistant
- Text Summarization
- Paraphrasing Tool
- Essay Generation
- Creative Writing
- Grammar Checking
- Academic Writing
- Content Creation
- Free Writing Tools
- Text-to-Image OCR
- Document Formatting
- Subscription Plans
- AI-Powered Generation

## Content Detection & Quality Assurance

- [Plagiarism Checker - Check 5000, 10000 & 15000 Words](https://www.editpad.org/tool/plagiarism-checker): Plagiarism Checker detects duplicate content for students and teachers
- [Grammar Checker](https://www.editpad.org/tool/grammar-checker): Free online grammar checker for spelling and punctuation errors
- [Punctuation Checker](https://www.editpad.org/tool/punctuation-checker): Free punctuation checker for grammar and writing assistance

## AI Writing Generation Tools

- [AI Essay Writer - Free Essay Generator](https://www.editpad.org/tool/ai-essay-writer): Free AI essay writer for all essay types in multiple languages
- [Story Generator - (Free, No Sign up)](https://www.editpad.org/tool/story-generator): Free AI story generator for creative writing without signup
- [AI Poem Generator - Free Poem Maker](https://www.editpad.org/tool/poem-generator): Free AI poem generator for haiku, sonnet, and acrostic poetry
- [AI Paragraph Generator - Free Paragraph Writer](https://www.editpad.org/tool/paragraph-generator): Free AI paragraph generator for engaging and informative content
- [AI Sentence Generator (Free)](https://www.editpad.org/tool/ai-sentence-generator): Free AI sentence generator for creative and coherent writing

## Text Processing & Transformation

- [Paraphrasing Tool - Rephrase Any Text (Free, No Sign-Up)](https://www.editpad.org/tool/paraphrasing-tool): AI-powered paraphrasing tool to rephrase text while preserving meaning
- [Text Summarizer - Best AI Summarizing Tool (Free)](https://www.editpad.org/tool/text-summarizer): Free AI text summarizer for articles, paragraphs, and essays
- [Extract Text From Image - Image to Text Converter](https://www.editpad.org/tool/extract-text-from-image): OCR tool to extract text from PNG, JPG, TIFF images
- [Text To Handwriting Converter - Create Assignments Online](https://www.editpad.org/tool/text-to-handwriting): Text to handwriting converter for creating assignments instantly

## Academic Writing Support

- [Thesis Statement Generator (Free)](https://www.editpad.org/tool/thesis-statement-generator): Free thesis statement generator for research papers and essays
- [Abstract Generator - Online Abstract Maker](https://www.editpad.org/tool/abstract-generator): Free abstract generator for articles with automatic title creation
- [AI Conclusion Generator: Write Strong Endings Instantly](https://www.editpad.org/tool/conclusion-generator): Free AI conclusion generator for essays, blogs, and research papers

## Writing & Editing Tools

- [Online Rich-Text Editor (html editor) - WYSIWYG editor](https://www.editpad.org/tool/online-rich-text-editor): Free WYSIWYG HTML editor powered by TinyMCE for text formatting

## Pricing & Account Management

- [Plans](https://www.editpad.org/tool/plans): Pricing plans and subscription tiers for EditPad AI writing tools

## Optional

- [Words to Pages - Count how many pages words are](https://www.editpad.org/tool/words-to-pages): Word-to-pages converter for essay planning and document analysis
